The top-left panel is front, top-right is right side, bottom-left is back, bottom-right is left side, each from its existing slightly elevated camera. Rebuild rough proxy surface details as finished materials and ornament from the appearance references; do not interpret proxy noise or faceting as intentional decoration. widgets_values:
## Splat & Solid

**Idol by Sperid Labs**, native ComfyUI integration by Comfy-Org and contributors. Optional image-guided refinement: **Hi3D**. Native mesh cleanup/rendering: **ComfyUI**; independent exported-file checks: **PyMeshLab and trimesh**. DINOv3, FLUX.2 autoencoder and BiRefNet retain their original credits and terms.

One image → splat + original mesh → optional refinement → closed master + lightweight companion. Appearance lives in the splat; the companion is separate geometry in its frame. Thin features may be lost. Closed geometry does not certify engine collision or physical printing.

This branch is independent of Turnaround, 3D-Guided and HairDeck. The wizard queues only its selected stage; nodes stay disabled for the global Run button. Saved loaders resume completed stages. Original files are preserved.

https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
